verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own programmatic surfaces. There is a Platform API with per-operation OpenAPI 3.0.2 specs, though it is access-gated. The CLI and MCP connectors can also pull transactions, financial statements and reports. However, no evidence names a general ledger or trial balance endpoint, or an open-format export of them, through the API. missing for 10: documented GL and trial balance API endpoints, an explicit open export format (CSV/JSON) for those reports, a publicly available (non-gated) API with a single downloadable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats

citations.quote: Authenticate, pick a workspace, and pull transactions or financial statements with the Kick CLI.
The Platform API is not yet publicly available. Access is enabled per organization by the Kick team.
